FeaturesList.EditorDescribe: Text, entities and relations. Everything is linked, everything makes sense
FeaturesList.CollaborationDescribe: Work together in real time or at your own pace. Fine-grained permissions included.

FeaturesList.OfflineDescribe: Plane, train, subway, bus, boat. Write everywhere, even without internet connection. Mythrart automatically synchronizes when you are back online.
